Check your store

Type a store's domain to see whether our latest weekly crawl (2026-10-26) found a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) profile, the machine-readable profile AI shopping agents read. We track 2276 retailers and stores. No UCP profile found doesn't mean AI agents can't shop there (details). Each store's page also lists its supporting signals: agent tools, AI rules in robots.txt, AI guidance files and product data.

How it works

  • This looks the domain up in our published results. It doesn't fetch anything from your store live.
  • Results are updated every Monday after the weekly crawl.
  • Not in the index? Use the link in the result to ask us to add it.
  • Have a UCP profile? Get a badge for your site.
